name: Bay St. Louis Beachfront RV Park
note: RV park at 5311 South Beach Blvd, Bay St. Louis, across the road from the Mississippi Sound beach and next to the Silver Slipper Casino: 37 concrete full-hookup pads (30/50 amp) plus 31 dry sites; self-contained RVs only (no bathhouse); golf-cart rentals. Online booking (Campspot). RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: bslrv.com read 2026-10-03: 37 full-hookup 30/50A concrete pads + 31 dry sites, self-contained RVs only, online booking up to a year out; RV Life 4.5* $$ (avg $39) over 85 reviews - passes price on tier

name: Hollywood Casino Tunica RV Park
note: Developed RV park beside the Hollywood Casino hotel at 1150 Casino Strip Resort Blvd, Robinsonville (Tunica): about 120 paved full-hookup sites in landscaped rows, with use of the hotel's amenities. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: RV Life 4* $$ (avg $23) over 132 reviews, 123 sites - passes price on tier; satellite shows paved RV rows with landscaped islands south of the hotel, a built park rather than an overnight lot (Sleeping Ute / Downstream precedent for developed casino RV parks); excluded as a casino lot in the 2026-06 sweep, reversed under that precedent; Google listing at the park with phone (read 2026-10-03)

name: Wolf River RV Resort
note: Wooded full-hookup RV resort at 23098 Freddie Frank Rd north of Pass Christian, by the Wolf River: nightly bookings open to the public (about $60 a night on the operator's site, 2026), plus lease and long-term options; a sister long-term park, Bayou RV Estates, sits next door. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: wolfriverrv.com read 2026-10-03: 'Book Your Stay Now' nightly online booking, full-hookup wooded sites, $60.00 per night shown, 99-year lease and member options alongside; Google 4.4 over 310 with phone; RV Life 4* $$ (avg $24) over 69 reviews - passes price on tier. name: Hidden Cove RV Park (Moss Point)
